description:
[FREE] Live status of the AgentPay Arc Agent Patrol: the automated
reputation oracle for the Arc ERC-8004 agent registry. Returns how many
external agents have registered, how many earned an on-chain x402
verification attestation, how many are auto-retrying unreachable
metadata, and the per-agent verdicts with attestation tx links.

The patrol scans every new agent registration, runs a real buyer-side
x402 check on its endpoint, and attests verified agents from a separate
validator wallet. Public report: x402-agent-pay.com/arc-patrol
name: get_arc_patrol_status
